imports.title: Imports

units.title: Teams
units.explain: Each row is a team, identified by its team code. Parents can come after their teams; re-importing the same file changes nothing.

people.title: People
people.explain: Each row is a person, matched by personal number or else by email. People listed again are reactivated; their teams are replaced by the file's.

seats.title: Seat assignments
seats.explain: Each row gives a seat to a person (by email) or reserves it for a team (by team code). Seats not in the file stay as they are; a taken seat is reassigned.

imports.choose: Choose a CSV or Excel file, or drop it here
